name: weaver
description: PALab Weaver monorepo. Workspace-level scripts only.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @palab/weaver-markdown && npm run compile -w @palab/weaver-vscode-extension
scripts.check: npm run build -w @palab/weaver-markdown && npm run check -w @palab/weaver-vscode-extension
scripts.dev: npm run build && node scripts/dev.js examples/sample-workspace
scripts.dev:docs: npm run build && node scripts/dev.js docs
